pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plan had a knight route e1-d3 with the king on e1; American spelling. Rewritten around ...Bb7 and the fight for e4.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plan had a knight route e1-g2-h4 through the king and the g2-bishop. Rewritten; reviewer rejection (...d5 blocks the b7-bishop's view of e4) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plans had Nf3-e1-g2 into the bishop's square and Qe1-h4 through the g3-pawn. Rewritten around Nbd2/e4 and Nh4/f4.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plans had Black trading dark-squared bishops to neutralise the light-squared g2-bishop and a route e1-d3 through the rook. Rewritten; reviewer rejection (g7-bishop said to aim at d4 through its own f6-knight) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Reti: KIA, Reti-Smyslov Variation
pages.notes: Plan read the c4-square as a move; overview generic. Rewritten around the double fianchetto, ...a5 and ...d6/...e5.

pages.name: Reti: Nimzowitsch-Larsen, 2...Bg4
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin (the e2-pawn shields the queen) and the g-file open after gxf3 (half-open); plan had gxf3 before ...Bxf3. Rewritten.

pages.name: King's Indian Attack: Keres Variation
pages.notes: Plans had White breaking a pin that does not exist and gxf3 before ...Bxf3. Rewritten; ...Bh5 dropped from the fight for e4 after the reviewer's note.

pages.name: King's Indian Attack: Keres Variation
pages.notes: Plan had the f3-knight going to d2 with the d2-pawn there; American spelling. Rewritten around ...Ngf6, ...e6/...c6 and ...e5.

pages.name: King's Indian Attack: Sicilian Variation
pages.notes: Plans used e4-e5 as a route and a knight route d2-f1-e3 through the f1-bishop. Rewritten around the two Black structures.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plan used an e3-e4 route with the pawn on e2 and an Ng4 route. Rewritten as a King's Indian Defence with colours reversed.
